name: inline-images
description: See pictures in the transcript, as the desktop app shows them: the images Claude reads, the ones you paste and those its answers link to; GIFs play.

rows.title: Picture height
rows.description: The most terminal rows a picture takes in the transcript.

animate.title: Play GIFs
animate.description: Play animated GIFs while they show on screen. Off, the first frame shows.

markdown.title: Pictures in answers
markdown.description: Show the local pictures an answer embeds with markdown (![alt](path)) or names (a path, or a file name found under the working folder), each under the paragraph that first shows it.

window.title: Preview in a window
window.description: A picture (or its name, or a chip) under the pointer opens larger, at full quality, in a small window of its own by the pointer, outside the terminal, in any terminal: the picture drawn small in the transcript, or in cells where the terminal cannot draw it (the VS Code terminal, Windows Terminal, Terminal.app…). macOS, Windows, WSL, and Linux with X11 and Python's tkinter; needs the fullscreen interface. The window opens at once with a spinner, and the picture fills it. Off, the transcript's drawing is all.

compact.title: Compact view
compact.description: Every picture (one Claude reads, one you paste, one an answer shows) is a chip with its name instead of drawn, and the pointer on a chip opens the picture at full quality in a window by the pointer. Needs the fullscreen interface and the window (Preview in a window on, and a desktop: not over ssh); elsewhere the pictures are drawn.

click.title: Open on click
click.description: A click on a picture or a chip opens it in the system's default viewer. Needs the fullscreen interface.
